summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  What I found is, honestly, **surprisingly clean**: - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request — cookies go out on watchlist calls. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware (mirrors the pattern used for `/api/portfolio/*` in `server.ts`) that requires a valid `arca_session` cookie, resolves it to a user via `getSession()`, and injects `X-User-Id`. Eve
